claims.text: The hotel sits right on the Rhine, in the heart of Basel's Old Town.

findings.quote: Perched right on the Rhine, in the heart of Basel’s Old Town

claims.text: The inn 'Drei Konige', meaning Three Kings, was first mentioned in 1681.

findings.quote:
1681

First mention of the inn "Drei Könige" (Three Kings).

claims.text: In 1754 innkeeper Johann Christoph Im Hof mounted three wooden king figures on the inn's facade.

findings.quote:
1754

Innkeeper Johann Christoph Im Hof mounts three wooden king figures on the facade of his inn

claims.text: In 1797 General Napoleon Bonaparte stopped at the inn while passing through and was received with a state reception.

findings.quote:
1797

While passing through, General Napoléon Bonaparte stops at the "Drei Könige" and is received with a magnificent state reception.

claims.text: Basel architect Amadeus Merian was commissioned to design the new building that replaced the old inn.

findings.quote: Senn decides to demolish the old inn and commissions the renowned Basel architect Amadeus Merian to design a new building.

claims.text: The new hotel 'Des Trois Rois' opened its doors on February 16, 1844.

findings.quote:
1844

On February 16, the new hotel "Des Trois Rois" opens its doors.

claims.text: Empress Michiko of Japan, writer James Joyce and artist Pablo Picasso were all guests of the hotel.

findings.quote: Empress Michiko of Japan, writer James Joyce, and artist Pablo Picasso – they were all guests of our hotel

claims.text: The Thomas Straumann family acquired the hotel in 2004.

findings.quote:
2004

The Thomas Straumann family acquires the "Drei Könige" and the southern section at Blumenrain 2.

claims.text: Rooms and suites are in the historic main building at Blumenrain 8 and the newly redesigned head building at Blumenrain 2.

findings.quote: Located in the historic main building at Blumenrain 8 and the newly redesigned head building at Blumenrain 2

claims.text: The hotel held 3 Keys in the Michelin Guide in 2025.

findings.quote:
2025

Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois, 3 Keys in the Michelin Guide

claims.text: Brasserie Les Trois Rois held 15 GaultMillau points in 2025.

findings.quote:
2025

Brasserie Les Trois Rois, 15 GaultMillau points

claims.text: The Seijaku Wellbeing area is reserved exclusively for hotel guests.

findings.quote: Our Seijaku Wellbeing area is reserved exclusively for hotel guests

claims.text: Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl held 3 stars in the Michelin Guide in 2025.

findings.quote:
2025

Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl, 3 stars in the Michelin Guide

claims.text: In June 2025, after a two-year transformation by Herzog & de Meuron, the listed head building at Blumenrain 2 was unveiled.

findings.quote: In June 2025, a new chapter begins: following a two-year transformation, the listed head building at Blumenrain 2 reveals its new splendour.
Start of the comprehensive renovation and extension of the head building at Blumenrain 2, led by the renowned architectural firm Herzog & de Meuron.

claims.text: Seijaku, a wellbeing area built around Japanese mindfulness culture, sits high above the city's rooftops in a building designed by Herzog & de Meuron.

findings.quote: High above the rooftops of the city, in a building designed by the renowned architects Herzog & de Meuron, lies a sanctuary
it is an immersive experience of Japanese mindfulness culture

claims.text: Restaurant Banks at Blumenrain 2 offers social dining with a European-Asian flair.

findings.quote: On 12 September, the restaurant Banks opens at Blumenrain 2. Social dining with a European-Asian flair

claims.text: The Council, the hotel's cigar lounge, has two fireplaces and 570 handcrafted tiles.

findings.quote: The Council, the new Cigar Lounge, opened its doors. Two fireplaces, 570 handcrafted tiles

claims.text: The interiors are a tribute to Belle Epoque grand hotels rather than an exact restoration.

findings.quote: The 101-room hotel isn’t an exact restoration but rather a tribute to the sumptuousness of Belle Epoque grand hotels

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes the historic building has traditional room configurations.
